results.title: *Finding Emily*
results.description: I very much enjoyed this British movie, which reminded me of the older-style romantic comedies, namely the ones that actually favor love and romance. It also has themes of class/accent, US/UK, is anti-media, anti-cancel culture, anti-podcast (Laura Lewis steals the show), anti-academia, and is sceptical of certain branches of feminism. But it is mostly entertaining. [...] The post *Finding Emily* appeared first on Marginal REVOLUTION .

results.title: Thalapathy Vijay could have teamed up with Vetrimaaran and Sudha Kongara before 'Beast', reveals music composer GV Prakash Kumar
results.description: In a recent revelation, composer GV Prakash Kumar discussed potential collaborations with Thalapathy Vijay that fell through. Vijay was supposed to join forces with directors Vetrimaaran and Sudha Kongara before the film Beast came out. Interestingly, Kongara later pitched her script to Mahesh Babu, which sadly didn't progress either. Meanwhile, GV Prakash is busy composing for Ajith Kumar's motorsport documentary, marking the end of Vijay’s acting career with Jana Nayagan.
